cohort: The study included 500 women who underwent IUCD insertion at a tertiary care hospital over a period of 1 year.
finding: The overall expulsion rate of postpartum IUCDs at 3 months was 5.6%, with no significant difference between different timings of insertion.
mod_finding: Intra-caesarean IUCD insertions had the highest expulsion rate (6.5%), followed by immediate postpartum (6.1%) and extended postpartum (3.2%), but the difference was not statistically significant.
